notes.title: 4.21.0update
notes.content:
1. The Season Arena is here! Ranked and Honor battles are on the horizon, and the battle situation of three decks is unpredictable, waiting for you!
2. Add season classification to the editing content of the deck, and you can choose to specify the season card for configuration.
3. Optimize and fix some bugs.
